We conduct experiments across a wide range of multimodal reasoning benchmarks, including charts, geometry, commonsense, science, mathematics, etc.

Humans often rely on intuitive Chain-of-Thought (CoT) to perform complex reasoning. Previous studies have shown that this CoT capacity also emerges in Large Language Models (LLMs). Through simple prompting or fine-tuning, CoT enhances the reasoning performance of LLMs while providing insights into their decision-making process.
